friction_events.description: The first authority-bearing GitHub claim CREATE received an explicit safety-control denial before ownership existed.

decision_trace.decision: Create a fresh v3.30 identity before allocation.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Fresh-launch policy requires a de-novo beacon as the first durable worker write.
decision_trace.action: Created the fresh beacon and froze worker_id plus launch_nonce.

decision_trace.decision: Use pool hash sharding on the one compact frontier snapshot.
decision_trace.observable_basis: POOL PROD-01 with a non-empty compatible candidate array and beacon commit seed selected the published ready candidate at index 2.
decision_trace.action: Attempted the allocator-supplied atomic PIN CREATE without pre-reading the claim path.
decision_trace.outcome: Explicit safety-control denial occurred before authority existed.

decision_trace.decision: Stop without retry or diversion after explicit denial.
decision_trace.observable_basis: CLAIM_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED is terminal before authority under the active canary contract.
decision_trace.action: Persisted one bounded no-allocation boundary receipt and prepared terminal E9 audit.
decision_trace.outcome: No project authority was acquired and no substantive project mutation was performed.

top_time_sinks.note: Terminal connector/safety denial on the first authority CREATE.

unfinished_debt.item: The selected elastic-kernel hardening job was not claimed or executed by this worker.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Make explicitly user-authorized reversible atomic PIN CREATEs pass the connector safety boundary when the exact allocator-supplied claim path and payload are used.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Reduce fresh workers that successfully beacon but terminate before ownership because claim transport is blocked.

exit_audit_v1.public_safe_summary: Fresh PROD-01 worker created its v3.30 beacon, loaded one compact frontier, then stopped at E2 because the first allocator-supplied authority CREATE was explicitly denied by the connector safety control. Boundary and exit evidence were persisted; no project authority or substantive mutation occurred.
